newsitem.title: USA: Sealright Corp Q4 loss after charge.
newsitem.headline: Sealright Corp Q4 loss after charge.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: 1996 Q4 loss includes loss from continuing operations of 3.7 million or $0.34 a share, a loss from discontinued operations of $3.55 million or $0.32 a share, a pre-tax restructuring charge of $1.5 million for plant consolidation, and pre-tax charges of $5.7 million from sale of assets used in a Los Angeles operation that makes plastic containers for cultured dairy products.
(All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: 1996 year loss includes loss from continuing operations of $808,000 or $0.07 a share, a loss from discontinued operations of $5.0 million or $0.45 a share, a pre-tax restructuring charge of $4.8 million and pre-tax charges for discontinued plastics operations of $7.8 million.

NOTE: 1995 Q4 loss includes loss from continuing operations of $12.6 million or $1.14 a share, loss from discontinued operations of $113,000 or $0.01 a share, and extraordinary charge of $94,000 or $0.01 a share.

1995 year loss includes loss from continuing operations of $4.8 million or $0.44 a share, loss from discontinued operations of $799,000 or $0.07 a share, and extraordinary charge of $94,000 or $0.01 a share.
